verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents scheduled data exports that send app data to cloud storage or email, which directly covers part of a bulk-export exit path. The evidence does not say exports include every subscription, invoice and usage record, and nothing covers porting stored payment methods to another provider. The migration docs describe importing into RevenueCat, not moving out. missing for 10: documented export schema covering subscriptions, invoices and usage records, any stored-payment-method portability to another provider, independent corroboration of a full exit/export.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: RevenueCat delivers your apps' data to a cloud storage provider or to email on a schedule you control.
